name: workflow
description: Discover, inspect, and synchronously run an enabled deterministic workflow from the shared or personal workflow folders. Search first when unsure. run waits for the complete workflow result while progress updates continue; after a successful run, answer from its result and do not repeat the workflow or its component tools.

action.description: search returns compact runnable matches; describe shows one compact recipe; run executes it in the foreground and returns the final result.

query.description: For search, describe the task to match. For run, provide the user's workflow input such as a topic, URL, location, or search phrase.

workflow_id.description: Exact workflow_id returned by search or describe. Required for describe and run.

limit.description: Maximum search matches. Defaults to 6 and is capped at 20.
